answer: The lagoon schedule is applied in dune and lantern makes public each instalment. An farming party thus cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split so that 38% arrives at settlement and the rest over 13 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 791 identities would post 4773 proofs and burn roughly 13 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
